name: MAV3D
definition: Synthesizes time-varying 3D scenes directly from text by optimizing a 4D neural radiance field under guidance from a pretrained text-to-video diffusion model.
summary: MAV3D synthesizes time-varying 3D scenes from text prompts using a hexplane-based 4D-NeRF and data-free diffusion supervision, avoiding the need for multi-view video inputs.
